verdict.rationale: Crossplane is API-first: its own resources (Managed Resources, Composite Resource Definitions, Compositions, packages) are declarative Kubernetes-style APIs, and the vendor says these APIs are built for humans, automation, and AI systems to act on, with RBAC. Since its capabilities are configured through these APIs and the CLI rather than a separate UI, there is no evident UI-only surface. missing for 10: an explicit statement of API/UI parity (no UI is documented to compare against), independent or hands-on corroboration that every operation is reachable via the API.
